# Code of conduct

## Our pledge

We want ReTerraForged's issues, pull requests and discussions to be a friendly place for everyone, whatever their
experience, age, background, identity or the language they speak.

## Our standards

Good:

- being kind and patient, also with people who are new to modding or to English;
- giving and taking feedback on the work, not on the person;
- saying thanks, and owning up to mistakes.

Not acceptable:

- insults, harassment, trolling and personal attacks;
- sexual language or imagery;
- publishing other people's private information;
- spam and advertising unrelated to the project.

## Enforcement

The maintainer ([@Vladeezyy](https://github.com/Vladeezyy)) may edit, hide or remove comments, issues and pull
requests that break these rules, and block people who keep breaking them.

To report a problem, use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment, issue or pull request (the "..." menu),
or [report the user to GitHub](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam).
Reports are looked at privately and fairly.
